AI photo denoising — removes noise, JPEG artifacts, and grain while preserving detail. No verified ONNX export is currently available (the previously listed huggingface.co/Heliosoph/scunet-onnx URL returns 404; cszn/SCUNet has documented ONNX conversion failures). Needs a verified source before this feature can download a model. Input: 512x512 RGB (auto-resized).

SAM2 Hiera Tiny — interactive object segmentation via point/box prompts ("Select Subject" tool). Virtual grouping entry — not directly downloadable itself. See sam2-hiera-tiny-encoder and sam2-hiera-tiny-decoder, both required.

Select Subject — image encoder (runs once per image). ~134MB. Verified source: vietanhdev/segment-anything-2-onnx-models on Hugging Face (Apache-2.0). Graph inspected directly 2026-07-21 (opset 17, no custom ops): input image [1,3,1024,1024] -> outputs image_embed [1,256,64,64], high_res_feats_0 [1,32,256,256], high_res_feats_1 [1,64,128,128]. No SHA-256 pinned yet — compute and pin on first verified download.

Select Subject — prompt decoder (runs per click/drag, using the cached encoder output). ~20.6MB. Verified source: vietanhdev/segment-anything-2-onnx-models on Hugging Face (Apache-2.0). Graph inspected directly 2026-07-21 (opset 17, no custom ops): inputs image_embed/high_res_feats_0/high_res_feats_1 (from encoder) + point_coords/point_labels/mask_input/has_mask_input -> outputs masks + iou_predictions. No SHA-256 pinned yet — compute and pin on first verified download.

AI depth estimation — powers Lens Blur's background blur. Verified source: onnx-community/depth-anything-v2-small on Hugging Face (Apache-2.0, converted from the official depth-anything/Depth-Anything-V2-Small checkpoint). Using the INT8 variant (~27MB) over FP32 (~99MB) to keep the one-time download reasonable on constrained connections and 4GB-RAM devices. Input: 518x518 RGB (multiple of 14). Output: relative depth map. Normalization: ImageNet (mean=[0.485,0.456,0.406], std=[0.229,0.224,0.225]). No SHA-256 pinned yet — compute and pin on first verified download.
SAM2 Hiera Small — higher quality interactive segmentation. ~92MB. Requires merged single-file ONNX export. For export instructions see: facebookresearch/sam2 scripts/export_onnx_model.py
Microsoft TrOCR-base-printed — OCR for printed Latin text in images and scanned documents. ~340MB. Not yet available as download — requires ONNX export from HuggingFace transformers.
Font detection ResNet — identifies font families from text region images. ~44MB. Not yet available as download — model export pending.
